name: Summed Inequality Sampler
description: Selects experimental conditions based on inequality relative to a reference pool.

parameters.name: num_samples
parameters.description: Number of samples to select from the condition pool.

parameters.name: equality_distance
parameters.description: Distance threshold for considering two data points as equal. Points closer than this threshold are treated as identical.

parameters.name: metric
parameters.description: Distance metric for measuring dissimilarity between conditions.

inputDataType.name: conditions
inputDataType.description: Pool of candidate experimental conditions to evaluate.

inputDataType.name: reference_conditions
inputDataType.description: Reference pool of existing experimental conditions to compare against.

outputDataType.name: conditions
outputDataType.description: Selected experimental conditions with highest inequality scores.
